svg.title: A single-layer teleportation platform
svg.desc: Isometric view of a seven by seven gold foundation with a Lodestone above its centre. A side view shows the gold block underneath the Lodestone.
svg.metadata: Fixed by Design schematic. Unmodified Minecraft textures: Mojang Studios. Not an in-game screenshot.

g.text: The centre block stays in place.
A single layer, including all 49 blocks.
